attempts.summary: On node1, blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false directives), confirmed it was not loaded, rebuilt the initramfs, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and verified post-restart that usb-storage remains unloaded, the blacklist config persisted, and a manual modprobe attempt is correctly blocked.
